## [Misleading and Frustrating Experience…](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/69ee7cf0c10e2a28ebe0aa39)

Misleading and Frustrating Experience with Lulu & Georgia

My experience with Lulu & Georgia has been extremely disappointing. Their policies are unclear, inconsistently applied, and ultimately left me paying for services they are now refusing to provide.

I spent just under $18,000 on outdoor furniture, including $1,307 in delivery fees for what was presented as white glove delivery—a service that includes placement of furniture and removal of all packaging. Based on that, I reasonably expected all large items to be delivered and set up accordingly. At no point was it clearly communicated otherwise.

Instead, over the past month, I’ve received a steady stream of deliveries—many via FedEx—without placement or packaging removal. The volume has been so excessive that one entire bay of my garage is now unusable.

Trying to resolve this has been equally frustrating. There is no direct phone support, and reaching a real person was not an option. When I finally connected with customer service, via email I was told that delivery methods are “clearly stated” on each product page. However, this information is inconsistent. Some items that were shipped via FedEx were listed as “white glove delivery,” yet that service was not honored.

When I asked whether customers are expected to review each individual product page to determine delivery logistics, I was given no clear answer—despite asking multiple times.

I also requested assistance with placing the larger items I physically cannot move, but was told no. This leaves me in the position of having to hire movers and arrange disposal of excessive packaging—services I already paid Lulu & Georgia to provide.

Their resolution was a $150 credit, which does not come close to addressing the inconvenience or additional costs I now face.

For a company operating at this price point, the lack of transparency, accountability, and customer support is unacceptable. I even attempted to escalate the issue by including founder Sara Sugarman in correspondence, but received no response.

If you are considering a large purchase, I strongly recommend looking elsewhere. This experience has been unnecessarily stressful and far from what was promised.

March 22, 2026

Unprompted review

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Apr 28, 2026

Hi Denise,

Thank you for reaching out and sharing your experience. I can see how frustrating this situation has been, and we sincerely appreciate your patience. We want to assure you that our third-party freight carrier will complete the White Glove service, including the removal of any packaging left from previous deliveries, during your upcoming appointment. Please let us know if there’s anything else we can assist you with in the meantime, we are happy to help.

Lulu and Georgia
